description: React component for managing ticket types in an event planning application, including creation, editing, and removal of ticket types with capacity validation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates the form state with new value for a given key.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new ticket type, including validation and server request.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing ticket type with new values, validating against event capacity.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes a ticket type after user confirmation, if allowed.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Enters edit mode for a specific ticket type.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels editing mode for a specific ticket type.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edited values for a ticket type.

methods.name: updateEditValue
methods.description: Updates a specific field value for an editable ticket type.
